justifications.durability: tests/test_a_slow_read_names_what_it_measured.py:107 fails with the half-wall threshold and fixed label restored, which negative_control.log shows as 1 failed 4 passed EXIT=1.

justifications.fit: the new READ_SLOW and SLOW_ERRORS constants at reckon/_mcp_tools.py:12-15 follow the STORAGE_SLOW idiom beside them, and no added name carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_mcp_tools.py:246 sets READ_SLOW when the cause is computing and STORAGE_SLOW otherwise, so the error label follows the measurement the deadline already reported.

justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diffstat sits inside the manifest's declared orientation_write_paths, and no file outside the granted set changed.
